intro: One sugar donut has an estimated 250 kcal. The calories come from the fried dough and the sugar coating.
diet: Yes, once in a while. One donut has almost the same calories as a small plate of rice, but it's not very filling. The problem is it's easy to eat two or three at once. Enjoy one slowly and treat it as a treat.
tips: Buy just one, not a box of 6 for yourself.
Eat it after a meal with protein, not on an empty stomach.
Drink plain water or kopi o kosong, skip sweet drinks with it.

swap.name: 2 slices wholemeal bread + a little kaya
swap.why: Still sweet, but less oil and more fibre.

faq.q: Why do donuts deflate after frying?
faq.a: Usually the dough was over-proofed or the oil wasn't hot enough. Fry on medium-high heat.
Best eaten the same day. In an airtight container, they can last a day or two.

faq.q: What's the difference between potato donuts and normal donuts?
faq.a: Potato donuts have mashed potato in the dough, so they're softer and fluffier.
